transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because I just don’t feel real happiness or closeness anymore. My wife tries to get me to enjoy our old Sunday routines, and I go along with it, but I don’t really feel anything. Even when something goes well at work, it doesn’t register like it used to.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event?
Yeah. It started after the retrofit accident—about a year and seven months ago.
Have you been feeling this lack of happiness and closeness nearly every day since the accident?

Yeah, nearly every day. I can go through the motions with my wife on Sundays, and I know I used to enjoy that, but I just don’t feel the happiness or closeness. Same thing when work goes well—it doesn’t really mean anything to me.
Do you feel down or depressed most days?
I’m not sure I’d call it depressed. Mostly I just feel numb, like things don’t reach me the way they used to.
Do you still get enjoyment from things you used to like doing?
Not really. My wife tries to get me into our old Sunday routines, but I don’t feel the enjoyment or closeness I used to. Even when something goes well at work, it just doesn’t make me happy.
Have these feelings been going on continuously for at least two years?
No. It’s been since the retrofit accident—about a year and seven months now.
Since the accident, have you felt sad or low most days?
I’m not sure. I don’t really think of it as feeling sad—I just feel numb most of the time.
Since the accident, have you been feeling anxious or worried a lot?
Yeah. I keep thinking I can’t trust my own judgment anymore. If I miss one detail on a schedule or a machine setting, I worry somebody’s going to get hurt because of me.
Since the accident, have you felt sad or hopeless nearly every day?
I don’t know if I’d call it sad or hopeless. Mostly I just feel numb, like I’m going through the day without much feeling.
Since the accident, have you felt down most of the day nearly every day?

I don’t know if I feel down exactly. It’s more that I can’t really feel happy or close to anyone anymore. My wife tries to do our usual Sunday things, and even when something goes well at work, I just don’t feel much from it.
Do reminders of the retrofit accident make these feelings noticeably worse?

Yeah, especially then. It’s like whatever good feeling I might have just shuts off. My wife will try to do our usual Sunday routine, or something will go well at work, and I still can’t feel happy or close to her.
Do you have unwanted memories of the retrofit accident that keep coming back?
Yes. A plant alarm, seeing a retrofit checklist, even the smell of hot metal—any of that can put me right back there, seeing him on the floor and hearing everybody yelling for help.
Do you try to avoid reminders of the retrofit accident?
Yeah. I avoid that production line whenever I can—I’ll send someone else to walk it. And if people start talking about the rollout or the investigation, I usually shut the conversation down.
Since the accident, do you get unusually jumpy or easily startled?
Yeah. If a forklift backs up, a door slams, or an alarm chirps, I jump like something exploded. My whole body reacts, and my hands can shake for several minutes afterward.
Do you have nightmares about the retrofit accident?
Yeah. When I do sleep, I’ll jolt awake from dreams about the line. Most nights I’m lying there replaying it anyway, and then I wake up around three or four feeling like I never really rested.
During the retrofit accident, did you directly see someone badly injured or killed?
I’m not sure how to answer that. I don’t really want to go into what I saw.
During the retrofit accident, did you directly witness someone being seriously injured or killed?
I... I can’t really talk about that. I’m sorry.
During the retrofit accident, did you personally see someone get seriously injured or killed?
I don’t want to talk about what I saw. I avoid that line as much as I can now—send someone else—and I shut down any talk about the rollout or investigation.
At the time of the retrofit accident, did you directly witness someone being seriously injured or killed?
I can’t talk about whether I saw it. I avoid that line now whenever I can—I send someone else—and I shut down conversations about the rollout or investigation.
Were you physically present at the retrofit accident?
I’m not sure I can answer that right now. I don’t want to go into where I was that day.
